_news.title: Hong Kong insurer AIA Group posts 5% drop in Q3 new business value

finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 16 consecutive years
Trading at a low P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth

summary: AIA Group reported H1 2026 operating profit after tax of $4.2B, up 13% per share, with record value of new business rising 10% to $3.2B.
Company raised interim dividend 10% and now expects to exceed its 9-11% operating profit per share CAGR target for 2023-2026 period.
Operating ROE hit record 17.5%, up 200 basis points YoY, driven by profitable new business and disciplined capital management.
Strong growth across all major markets: mainland China VONB up 20%, Hong Kong/Macau up 10%, India's Tata AIA surged 31%.
Shares fell 1.51% to $71.90 in pre-market despite solid results, trading near 52-week low amid cautious investor sentiment.
